scientific_integrity: The complete formal-series and finite-sum identities are proved with precise embedded-submonoid equality and generator multiplicity; finite verification is corroborative. Standard functional-digraph decomposition and prior abstract isomorphism classifications are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Publication priority is not independently established. An equivalent embedded enumeration under other transformation-semigroup terminology remains possible. The asymptotic estimate is a proved upper bound, not a sharp equivalent.
title: Embedded monogenic transformation submonoids, refined by tail depth and cycle period
